description: The ONE input pin of the vendored @insimul/core bundle (corebridge/vendor/core/). tools/vendor-core-bundle.mjs bundles core at exactly `coreCommit` (a `git archive` of that commit, never the checkout's working tree) with exactly `esbuild`, and --check refuses a VENDORED.json that records anything else. Bump both here, then re-vendor.
coreRefNote: PL.native-props-rows (2026-11-09, rulings U89(2) and U36): the pin moved from fc88be9 to core main ac229a7, which holds every core item the Unreal-first queue landed after fc88be9 — P9b.core (101ff6a..d337ba5), P9c.core (f4efdba..4987cba), P9d.core (c66a793), P9e.core (2a84fc0, 6f51dc2), PL.adventure-combat-revert (3ce594c), PL.slots-delete-states (2e1706a: the delete prompt, whose ask_delete, confirm_delete and cancel_delete steps the saves.slots.apply row now takes, and a finished delete's history line), PL.quick-slot (895d2d9..280693b: an unset quickSlot is a dedicated quick slot at index slotCount), PL.read-clue-events (344c40c) and PL.pickup-placement (cd38a56, ac229a7) — and P6.core's props and inventory logic (31764b1: src/props/{containers,documents,doors,notice-board}.ts, src/ui/inventory-model.ts, game-engine/logic/NoticeGenerator.ts) with its corpora conformance/props/{containers,documents,doors,notice-board}.json and conformance/ui/inventory-cases.json, which the props.* and inventory.* rows run. Before that, PL.native-catchup (2026-11-09, rulings U87(4) and U84): the pin moved from f9aef13 to core main fc88be9, which holds every core item the Unreal-first queue landed after f9aef13 — PL.collect-target (6b07b9f), PL.criteria-quests (8f12efd), PL.core-mechanics-contract (798d333: MECHANIC_STEP_OPS exported as data from src/game-engine/mechanic-runtime-corpus.ts, which the mechanics.run row now imports in place of its hand copy, and the World IR's meta.enabledModules ['none'] token, which mechanics.run and modules.activate answer through core), PL.slots-offset-mirror (8ae718b), PL.weather-look-light (5179d0b), PL.save-weather (9caa203), PL.pass-by-core (556368c) and PL.house-blank-sides (fc88be9) — and P1.core-slots' SaveSlotsSession (a301b9d, src/save-slots.ts) with its corpus conformance/saves/slots.json, which the saves.slots.create and saves.slots.apply rows run. Before that, P9a.native (2026-11-07, rulings U84 and U79(4)): the pin moved from b38e60d to core main f9aef13, which holds P9a.core (a4b3aaf..00fc64a: every registry genre activates its mechanics, a world's meta.enabledModules reaches the activation, the genre HUD view-model and its corpus conformance/ui/genre-hud-cases.json, the world rules panel and its corpus conformance/ui/rules-panel-cases.json, and the mechanic runtime assembly src/game-engine/mechanic-runtime.ts with its corpus conformance/modules/mechanic-runtime.json) that the ui.genreHud, ui.rulesPanel and mechanics.run rows run, and levels the vendored packs/ trees with core (U81). Before that, SP.composer-native (2026-11-05, rulings U62(1) and U79(4)): the pin moved from 4a46789 to core main b38e60d, which holds SP.composer's composer (4ca7e9e, src/system-packs/composer.ts) and its corpus (conformance/packs/composition.json, 34 cases, with the packs/ catalog it names) that the packs.compose row runs. Before that, L.native-layout (2026-10-29, ruling U36): the pin moved from c4b46c4 to core main 4a46789, which holds L1's layout rules (bdfe79d, src/editor/layout/) and B9's composition rules (5d05c18 onward, src/editor/layout/composition/) that the layout.* rows run. Before that, the C0 landing (2026-10-16) pinned c4b46c4. To move it again: bump coreCommit and coreRef here, re-vendor, re-run --check --core and the corebridge, layout, packs, P9a, saves-slots and props corpus ctests.
